verdict.rationale: Column documents sending and receiving Fedwire domestic wires (column-docs-24, column-docs-12) and sending, receiving, and requesting payment over both FedNow and RTP (column-docs-6). These sit alongside a unified transfers endpoint and an OpenAPI-defined API (column-docs-9, column-docs-10, column-probe-2), and each rail has its own documentation page. Missing for 10: detail on per-rail capability differences such as limits, operating hours, and which features each instant rail supports, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of RTP/FedNow in use.
